title: APK buildout
summary: Extend the existing native development package into the complete Android participant experience and a reviewed distribution lifecycle.

goals.title: Android package foundation
goals.description: The existing development package, shared assets, native adapters and documented managed-container build contract.

milestones.title: Shared UI and native Android package foundation
milestones.description: The existing APK packages shared web UI/WASM, the Rust sensor/provenance core and Kotlin platform adapters under a documented managed Debian build/signature contract. This milestone is the development package foundation; the achievement date is unspecified.
acceptance: The APK bundles shared policy/verification and native permission, lifecycle, sensor and key adapters.
Documented Debian builds assemble/lint the package and inspect signatures without Windows Java.
Unsupported required sensor capabilities fail rather than silently using a reduced profile.
